rake is a development-only Gemfile dependency of fontist and is absent from the fontist tebako shipped closure. Scoped to fontist only: rake IS shipped in metanorma (a runtime dependency of google-protobuf), so this claim must never apply there.
The advisory is JRuby-only (NONET parse bypass via a short-form IPv4 host). fontist ships the CRuby native nokogiri gem on the CRuby 3.3.12 tebako runtime, so JRuby code paths cannot execute.

Exploitation requires ActiveSupport::MessagePack (which requires the msgpack gem) and ERB rendering of a deserialized SafeBuffer. msgpack is absent from the fontist tebako closure (ActiveSupport::MessagePack cannot be loaded), and fontist is a CLI with no Rails/ERB web rendering.

Exploitation requires Nokogiri::HTML5 serialization of untrusted HTML containing noscript elements sent to a browser. fontist makes zero Nokogiri::HTML5 calls (macos_importer.rb has only an unused require; sil_importer.rb uses HTML4 Nokogiri::HTML.parse solely to extract download links) and never serves serialized HTML to browsers.

Affects Addressable::URI#display_uri host display (bidi/invisible characters). fontist makes zero display_uri calls; addressable enters transitively via git/octokit/sawyer and is never used to render human-facing URIs.

actionStatement: Upgrade the fontist tebako package beyond 3.0.10 (fontist >= 3.0.43 resolves rubyzip >= 3.7.0, fixing CVE-2026-85396). Until upgraded, do not run fontist upgrade-formulas against untrusted ZIP archives.
statusNotes: fontist 3.0.10 ships rubyzip 2.4.1 (< 3.4.0) and lib/fontist/import/upgrade_formulas.rb#extract_zip passes unsanitized entry.name to Zip::Entry#extract.

fontist 3.0.10 ships activesupport 8.1.3 (< 8.1.4.1). Direct fontist code does not call safe_constantize, but ActiveSupport internals have not been exhaustively audited; resolved by rebuilding fontist on >= 3.0.43 (activesupport >= 8.1.4.1).

fontist 3.0.10 ships CRuby nokogiri 1.19.4 (< 1.19.5) and moxml wraps nokogiri XML node manipulation. Reachability of Node#[]= attribute replacement on untrusted XML is not disproven; resolved by rebuilding fontist on >= 3.0.43 (nokogiri >= 1.19.5).
